title: agrimonia japonica var. granulosa
intro: Agrimonia japonica var. granulosa, commonly known as Japanese agrimony, is a plant species native to East Asia that belongs to the Rosaceae family. The health benefits of Japanese agrimony include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, which can help to reduce the risk of chronic diseases such as cardiovascular disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Japanese agrimony include its ability to improve wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate symptoms of gastrointestinal disorders. The bioactive constituents of Japanese agrimony include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and stilbenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
